Markets.title: Sebi’s CAS guidelines likely within a week, says chief Tuhin Kanta Pandey
Markets.summary: Sebi expects to issue guidelines on the derivatives settlement-price mechanism within a week following a review of the Closing Auction Session. The regulator is also working on simpler regulations, easier market access, lower compliance costs, and stronger technological resilience.

Markets.title: Industrial, warehousing space leasing hits record 59.1 mn sq ft in top 24 cities in Jan-Sep: Savills
Markets.summary: Industrial and warehousing space leasing across India's top 24 cities reached a record 59.1 million square feet between January and September. This growth was driven by demand from e-commerce, third-party logistics, and light manufacturing sectors, with Tier-I cities accounting for 47.2 million square feet.

Markets.title: BPTP sells 150 apartments in its new housing project at Faridabad
Markets.summary: Real estate developer BPTP Ltd sold 150 luxury apartments in its Faridabad housing project, generating Rs 150 crore in revenue. The 'SkyNest' development has accumulated a total of approximately Rs 750 crore in sales, with individual flats averaging Rs 5 crore.

Markets.title: Adani Green Energy H1 Update: Operational capacity rises 24% YoY to 20,763 MW, energy sales jump 32%
Markets.summary: Adani Green Energy reported a 24% year-on-year increase in operational capacity to 20,763 MW for H1FY27, alongside a 32% jump in energy sales. The company's board is scheduled to review its Q2FY27 financial results on October 21.

Markets.title: DMart Q2 Results: Cons profit rises nearly 9% YoY to Rs 743 crore, revenue jumps 18%
Markets.summary: Avenue Supermarts reported an 8.5% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 743 crore for Q2FY27, alongside an 17.8% jump in revenue to Rs 19,644 crore. Despite opening 15 new stores to reach a total of 518, the company experienced declining EBITDA and profit margins due to entry-level wage inflation.

Markets.title: Bitcoin reclaims $82,500 as improved ETF flows lift market sentiment. Here is what experts say
Markets.summary: Bitcoin recovered to $82,500 on Saturday following improved ETF flows, though it remained down for the week amid substantial derivatives liquidations. Experts warned that ongoing risks include institutional outflows, US-Iran tensions, and AI-related security concerns.

Geo-Political.title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal
Geo-Political.summary: Former US President Donald Trump stated that Ukraine needs a new leader after President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized a diesel deal with Russia. Zelensky had argued that the transaction helps Moscow finance its ongoing war.

Geo-Political.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia killed at least 15 people, including children. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the strike occurred in response to a US diesel deal.

Geo-Political.title: Several injured in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh
Geo-Political.summary: Several people were injured in an attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The incident occurred just days after Yemen's Houthi movement claimed responsibility for a previous strike on the same facility.

Geo-Political.title: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
Geo-Political.summary: Christa Pike, a convicted US murderer, was discharged from the hospital ten days after surviving two botched lethal injection attempts. Her lawyers reported that she is grateful to the medical staff who provided her care.

Geo-Political.title: Four dead and thousands without power after Hurricane Isaias lashes US
Geo-Political.summary: Hurricane Isaias made landfall in Florida as a storm before being downgraded to a post-tropical cyclone. The severe weather left four people dead and thousands without power across the United States.

Geo-Political.title: Expedition hopes to find aviator Amelia Earhart's plane on remote island
Geo-Political.summary: An expedition is traveling to a remote island to search for Amelia Earhart's airplane. The team hopes to finally solve the mystery of her disappearance in 1937.

Data & Insights.title: Economic think tank says govt should withdraw proposed UPI charges. Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: An economic think tank has urged the government to withdraw a proposed 0.4% fee on UPI merchant transactions exceeding ₹2,000. The organization warned that the fee would increase prices, squeeze small businesses, and weaken consumer demand.

Data & Insights.title: RBI may hike repo rate by 75-100 bps in current cycle as inflation persists- SBI Capital flags December hike risk
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Capital warns that persistent inflation could force the RBI to raise the repo rate by 75 to 100 basis points in the current cycle. While gradual rate increases are the most likely outcome, a larger hike cannot be ruled out for December 2026.

Data & Insights.title: Reserve Bank of India takes steps to support rupee, opens dollar window for oil companies
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is directly supplying dollars to three state-run oil companies and tightening currency derivative rules to support the weakening rupee. These measures aim to reduce foreign-exchange market demand and volatility while the currency trades near its record low.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: rate hikes, SIP flows, Airtel’s tariffs
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly compilation features data-driven charts and insights based on Mint's reporting from the past week. The topics covered include rate hikes, systematic investment plan (SIP) flows, and Airtel's tariffs.

Data & Insights.title: CEA bats for a review of loan overdue rules for MSMEs
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Adviser V. Anantha Nageswaran has recommended adjusting MSME loan overdue rules to match their actual cash-flow cycles. He argued that regulators should avoid using rigid, uniform global standards for these businesses.

Data & Insights.title: EU-China trade breakthrough: Beijing agrees to moderate hybrid car exports by more than half | Here's what we know
Data & Insights.summary: China agreed to reduce its hybrid car exports to the European Union by more than half. This deal is intended to reduce trade tensions between Beijing and the EU.

India.title: Cafe Owner Dies After Falling From Balcony, Influencer Girlfriend Accused Of Murder
India.summary: An Indian cafe owner named Shiva Sharma died Friday night after falling from a balcony in Hazratganj. His mother has accused his influencer girlfriend, Shraddha Dubey, of murder, alleging that Dubey had threatened to defame him with obscene videos.

India.title: Top Court To Hold Special Hearing Tomorrow On Delhi Metro Closure, Protest Detentions
India.summary: India's Supreme Court will hold a special hearing tomorrow regarding the closure of the Delhi Metro and the detention of protesters. Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana will preside over the scheduled matters.

India.title: Huge Cache Of Arms, Ammunition Recovered From Cave In Jammu And Kashmir
India.summary: Security forces recovered a large cache of arms and ammunition from a natural cave in the Mukaam Cherhar forests of Jammu and Kashmir. The weapons were hidden inside a blue plastic barrel and a bag beneath a large boulder during an intelligence-based operation.

India.title: Akal Takht Says No Point Meeting Bhagwant Mann To Seek Release of 'Bandi Singhs'
India.summary: Akal Takht Jathedar Giani Kuldip Singh Gargajj has instructed SGPC member Karnail Singh Panjoli not to meet Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann. The directive was issued regarding discussions about the release of Sikh political prisoners, known as 'Bandi Singhs'.

India.title: Delhi CJP Protest News LIVE: Delhi Metro Gates Reopened, Internet Services Restored Around Jantar Mantar
India.summary: Entry and exit gates at 45 Delhi Metro stations, including Rajiv Chowk and New Delhi, were closed due to protests. Internet services around Jantar Mantar and closed metro gates have now been restored.

India.title: All 3,000 Detainees Released, Except Abhijeet Dipke, Dhruv Rathee, 2 Others
India.summary: Authorities in Delhi detained around 3,000 people who had gathered for sit-in protests near Jantar Mantar. While all other detainees have now been released, Abhijeet Dipke, Dhruv Rathee, and two other individuals remain in custody.
